subject: Adaptive retriever tuning, reranker decision & next steps (Kaleido Health)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 22:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap: Kaleido RAG discovery (notes + proposed next steps)

Hi Marcus / Monica,

Quick post-call recap from the Kaleido Health discovery (joined by Elena Park, Tom Rios). High level: they want a RAG workflow that avoids hallucination on regulatory guidance and clinical QA docs; their main concerns are grounding fidelity and predictable latency at 99th percentile for short queries.

What we captured:
- Data surface: ~120k docs (policy memos, Q&As, SOPs) to embed; avg chunk size 450–700 tokens.
- Success criteria: 
  - Grounding rate > 92% (responses include at least one accurate doc citation)
  - Contradiction rate < 3% on our curated prompt set
  - 99th percentile latency < 850ms (hosted mode target)
- Immediate ask from Kaleido: sample eval dataset (they can share redacted Q&A CSV), and a lightweight benchmark run with 3 retriever configurations.

My proposed internal plan (short):
1) Run fast benchmark with two retrievers: dense-vector (FAISS flat) with 512-d embeddings (text-embedding-3-small) and an ANN HNSW index tuned for recall.
2) Reranker A/B: simple dot-product re-rank (bi-encoder) vs a cross-encoder (cross-encoder/ms-marco-style) on top 50 hits.
3) Model candidates for generation: rw-13b-v2-qa (quantized) and llama2-13b-chat; include a lighter 7b chat for latency-sensitive queries.
4) Prompt set: use their shared promptset_v2.txt (attached) + our curated guardrails for quoting sources.

Attachments I dropped for internal reference: kaleido_rag_benchmarks_v1.csv (bench harness), promptset_v2.txt. Also added a short AB-test proposal draft.

Decisions we need from the team:
- Which reranker baseline do we run first? My vote: cross-encoder for fidelity (even if more expensive) on the initial pass so we can establish an upper bound.
- Do we enable prefix KV caching for the 13b models in the benchmark to simulate production?

Next internal steps: Marcus — can you spin up the FAISS flat and HNSW variants and run recall@k for their sample dataset? Monica — can you prep the reranker config + scoring hooks (grounding_rate, contradiction_rate) and a quick dashboard link?

Thanks,
Stephanie

--

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Kaleido RAG discovery (next steps + data request)

Thanks for the dataset and the link, Elena. Quick tech reply with recommendations and the AB plan we can run immediately.

Short answers to Elena's Qs:
- Embeddings: start with text-embedding-3-small for speed and cost; if recall@10 < 0.9 we will increase dimensionality (switch to text-embedding-3-large or add chunk-overlap to boost recall).
- Grounding_rate definition: percentage of responses where the top-1 cited doc contains the canonical answer phrase (we'll do fuzzy matching + sentence overlap threshold >= 0.7). We'll also surface contradiction_rate (explicit contradictions between generated text and cited docs) flagged by a comparator model.

AB test plan (run on the 1.8k-doc sandbox):
A) Retriever config: FAISS flat (exact) + bi-encoder rerank (dot prod)
B) Retriever config: HNSW ANN + cross-encoder rerank (cross-encoder applied to top 50)

For both A & B we'll measure: grounding_rate, contradiction_rate, recall@1/5/10, latency p50/p95/p99, and cost-per-query. We'll run 1k queries from your redacted_qna_v1.csv as an initial sweep.

Model routing: If cross-encoder + 13b generator achieves grounding_rate >= 92% and contradiction_rate < 3% with p99 latency < 850ms for 7b but slightly higher for 13b, we'll propose a hybrid production route: 7b-chat (low-latency path) for simple queries and 13b-qa behind a cross-encoder fallback for high-fidelity answers.

Deliverables & timing:
- Bench run + dashboard: 48 hours after we kick off (we can start now that we have the Drive link)
- Short deep-dive: propose Fri 21 Aug 2026 11:00 AM PT; Stephanie will run through results and recommend a pilot config.

Notes on observability: we'll instrument grounding_rate per-prompt and add a per-prompt regression alert (if grounding_rate drops >4% vs baseline on a monthly rolling window).

I'll start the runs and post a link to the dashboard once the first wave completes.

—Marcus
